عضضتن (form I)
# عَضِضْتُنَّ (ʕaḍiḍtunna) /ʕa.dˤidˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of عَضَّ (ʕaḍḍa)
# عُضِضْتُنَّ (ʕuḍiḍtunna) /ʕu.dˤidˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of عَضَّ (ʕaḍḍa)
